metadata.normalization: Accept finite [0,1] vectors with positive sum within min(0.05, 0.0051 * classes) of 1; divide every accepted vector by its sum before scoring and top-probability routing.
metadata.prediction: Must be a maximum-probability class; ties are allowed.
metadata.brier: Mean over valid records of SUM over classes (normalized probability - one-hot target)^2.
metadata.nll: Mean natural-log loss over valid records; gold probability clamped to 1e-12; exact zeros counted separately.
metadata.ece: 10 equal-width bins [lower, upper), last bin includes 1; sample-weighted absolute mean-score minus accuracy.
metadata.confidence: Distribution-shape statistic diagnostic, NOT a claimed probability of correctness. Null confidence is excluded from its ECE and mean score and routes to human_candidate.
metadata.denominators: Accuracy and route coverage use all attempts. Invalid records count wrong and route to human_candidate. Brier/NLL/ECE use valid available scores only. Empty denominators return null.
metadata.risk: 1 - bucket accuracy, including invalid attempts as wrong in human_candidate.
metadata.interval: Two-sided Wilson 95% interval for bucket accuracy (z=1.959963984540054); descriptive, not adjusted for dependence or multiple comparisons.
metadata.routing: Both score types use >=0.9 auto_candidate, >=0.7 stronger_model_candidate, otherwise human_candidate. These are offline candidate labels; no actions are executed.
